title: Separate Tauri PR Validation From Release Write Authority
primary_claim: Pull-request reachable desktop build and validation code executes with read-only repository permission and no persisted checkout credential; contents-write authority exists only in a push-to-main release job after the cross-platform desktop matrix succeeds.

baseline.finding: same-repository pull-request controlled npm/Python/Rust/Tauri code could execute in a job with repository contents-write authority

acceptance: no PR-reachable desktop build section contains contents: write
no PR-reachable desktop build section receives GITHUB_TOKEN explicitly
all checkout steps use persist-credentials: false
write authority is job-scoped to a push-only release job
release job runs only after the desktop matrix succeeds
release job downloads validated artifacts and does not rerun repository npm, Python build, smoke, Rust formatting, or Tauri build hooks
desktop packaging regression tests retain updater-disabled and platform/version invariants
residual_risks: third-party GitHub Actions remain referenced by floating major/stable tags; immutable action-SHA pinning is recommended as a separate supply-chain packet
release authority still trusts code already merged to main, which is the intended protected release boundary and depends on repository branch governance
main branch protection/ruleset work remains tracked separately in issue 241
rollback: restore the prior tauri-desktop workflow and packaging test blobs
retain this Work Packet and issue history as negative security evidence
evidence_status: prepared_source_and_static_contract_tests_only; no green test or workflow claim until exact-head commands execute
